overview: Hoppers can be placed pointing up. Aim at the bottom face of a block and the hopper you place lifts items instead of dropping them.
No new item and no recipe: it is the hopper you already have, aimed the way nobody tries.

2.0.1: Breaking an upward hopper gives its hopper back through the game's own loot table, and the readme now rides inside the jar.
2.0.0: An upward hopper holds a vanilla stack like every other hopper and answers a right-click the way one should.
With village-quests installed, a farmer who has carried grain up a ladder all their life asks you to build something that lifts.
1.0.0: Place a hopper against the bottom face of a block and it points up. Break it and you get an ordinary hopper back.
